note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The two lanes never meet and imply no hierarchy; chevrons only show direction of travel (sequence as configured, illustrative). Whether the effect is maintained or suspended is a SUPPLIED DATUM (finalState) printed on the tag; only the gate on the process lane depends on it. No suspension doctrine, dates or time limits; nothing is judged. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, actorLabels, objectLabels, annotations and finalState are editable.
